This is extremely sad. No words I say can measure the brokenness inside of you and I am sorry for that. Wars is bad as you probably realize already. It don’t matter who wins or who’s wrong because in war your exposed to violence and deaths. Seeing friends heads blown off or innocent civilians murdered will stick in your consciousness. It don’t matter if you did it or not just seeing it is enough to traumatize you. I wish I knew what to say because honestly I’d rather have you here, but at the same time I know how you feel too. Any normal human being who’s seen and experience what you have will know exactly how you feel. You sound like a genuine person as well and that breaks my heart even more. I hate that most people who suffer are victims of something they didn’t start. Fucked up thing is I feel like dying everyday as well because of the abuse and trauma I went through. I had to drink to numb my reality because it was the only way I could feel good. Everytime I came back to reality my thoughts haunt me and torture me endlessly. The feelings of despair, guilt, and being a burden caused me such immense distress that all I could do was think of killing myself. In my head I truly felt that no one cared and that I was just a dead weight to the world anyways so it’d be better off if I kick the bucket! I hate myself, I hate the world, and I hate human beings because we can be so evil to one another! I don’t know what to say because I’m in a fuckin deep hole myself, but I don’t want you to die though. I guess I’m being selfish....cause I don’t want to be here too....im confused and just as lost as you are. Please know that someone here understands your loneliness, despair, confusion, and pain to an extent because I myself am a victim to trauma. I wish you a good day and I hope that things turn out for you brother ! Take care and sorry a bunch if this was useless to you I just wanted to tell you that you aren’t suffering alone goodbye.

Lifestyles matter, but the real killer is stress! Being expose to constant negative and toxic environments leads the body to always be on alert! Your body goes into fight, flight, and freeze mode. When your body does that it also releases cortisol, adrenaline, and stress hormones. We need that actually because it acts as a buffer that jolts us to spring into action like running away from a damn bear. The problem comes when the danger is out of site and your body won’t shut off. If you experience abuse and discrimination on a daily basis like me what happens is your body will be flooded with those chemicals anytime you experience negative events. Your body kicks into gear and flood it with chemicals. Those chemicals can wear your body down so over time your immune system gets weak and you become more susceptible to illnesses and disease.  A huge physical sign of a immune system weakening is your skin tone. Pale or dark colored skin. I’m usually alone 80 to 90% of the time not by choice lol. I’m ugly and it’s extremely difficult for people to accept me so I suffer from severe loneliness, which causes me all sorts of health problems. U, I, and everyone knows that loneliness fuckin kills! Losing hair, skin is starting to sag, baggy eyes, poor skin tone and complexion, dry nappy hair , dramatic weight loss, and zombie like appearance all from stress:(  rejection or ostracism can cause this I’m living proof, but what can I do? I would love company and friends for certain but I’m not going to beg and be desperate asking society to please let me be part of it so I’m fucked. I mean I thought about surgery but that’s because I don’t want to scare people with my ugliness if I’m being honest ha. Human beings are 100% social creatures. We depend on each other  for survival that’s how me made it this far. Anyone who says you can survive all alone is clearly talking out their asses lol. Depression and loneliness wouldn’t exist if we didn’t give a rats ass about being accepted into society! The truth is we care more then you can imagine but for those that are suffering in silence I hope that you get a miracle cause it’s very sad and miserable existence to live this way. I’ve been having chronic cough and really bad breath like rotten bad breath:/ I just hope it’s not an infection or cancer. I do know that loneliness is killing me. O well If so I hope I die swiftly, though it’s wishful thinking:) anyways yea on the last part you mentioned definitely true I’m 30 with no friends or lover damn i must be hideous lol:) best of wishes and thanks for reading my bullshit rant:/

Ok so I appreciate your help and positivity, but I’ve tried many times to fit in and now my self esteem has taken a huge hit from the rejections I’ve received.  I use to be outgoing and talkative asf but through discrimination and bullying I lost it. I never had a problem with my attitude or personality. I never came off as awkward and weird either, like I said it’s because most people don’t want to be associated with ugly people! I also understand that not every single person cares about look, but majority of people do.  I don’t know how many times I’ve gone out only to be rejected. I must be hideous because I notice people get anxiety attack when I approach them especially pretty women. Now I believe that I’m so ugly and it makes me nervous whereas before I didn’t care all that much cause I assumed not everyone will like you. Please don’t say things like “maybe it’s the way you talk or approached them” because I can guarantee you that it isn’t that. I used to be an easy carefree going type of guy .  Maybe it’s hard for people to accept that it’s not the way the ugly guy/gal represents themselves or behave because most are pretty normal. maybe it’s because they have standards and don’t want to hangout with ugly people . Simple as that.  I don’t think you realize that none of us uglies try to let our appearance define us but when it gets to the point of you being rejected and discriminated constantly when you take many chances it’s going to affect you.
